item.title: Frontier Airlines Will Shrink Massively By Returning & Deferring Planes
item.description: Over the past several years, we’ve seen the ultra low cost carrier business model in the United States under immense stress. With costs going up and the legacy carriers better competing, they’ve found themselves in a really challenging situation. Obviously Spirit Airlines is in the worst position, but Frontier Airlines isn’t exactly doing great either. Along those lines, there’s an interesting development on that front.
